arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Jones argued the law clearly established the conduct as unlawful.
Mr. Forrester cited eight Alabama judges who found no violation.
Mr. Schaerr argued common sense principles control the outcome.
Mr. Schlick stated immunity applies unless the violation was clear.
